question: In Slack: Add an eyes reaction to the release checklist message that Maya Chen posted in #launch-plan and that Diego Alvarez reacted to with thumbsup. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
I didn't add the reaction, because no message matches.

Maya Chen has one release checklist message in #launch-plan: "Updated the release checklist with the rollback steps." Diego Alvarez reacted to it with 👎 (thumbsdown), not 👍. Nobody else has reacted to it.

The only other checklist message in the channel is Omar Haddad's "My copy of the release checklist for Thursday…", and Maya didn't post that one.

If you meant Maya's rollback-steps message, I can add 👀 to it.
